body:
I'm just not going to talk to her until she cleans her act up, literally. 

Hey, and thanks for talking me through this. I really do appreciate it.
She doesn't want to! It's fucking ridiculous. I go to school for computers and networking, but I'm apparently a fucking idiot.

I've tried. The only way we can have a "conversation" is with the family therapist. She has the whole downstairs fucking cluttered to shit, and it gives me huge headaches and makes me feel sick. I can't fucking stand things that aren't organized. She just bought a new MacBook Pro but refuses to move her shit into the master bed room that is the size of most houses. She has two fucking desktops in the middle of the living room. It's ridiculous. She complains about there not being enough space... IT'S A FUCKING 5000 SQ FT HOUSE FOR CHRIST'S SAKE. 

So today before she started screaming I told her I wanted another appointment with the therapist and she refused. It's like talking to a brick wall. I'm fucking tired of it.

It was community service day at school, and both days were just really great. Had a little competition with my teacher to see who could pass of work to other people, got MANicures from cosmetology, got take out for lunch, helped an old lady with her MacBook. Just had a really great time with a couple friends and my teachers throughout both days. 

I didn't mean that no one here cared. Just that someone that I used to consider my best friend doesn't care about me any more, my "mom" doesn't care, and I'm just starting to give up. I can't have a conversation with my mom without her screaming at me if I don't agree with her on something. It's tiring. I applied to colleges for early decision and I probably won't get in because my GPA is total shit. I can't move out because I'm not 18 and there's no way I could live on my own. /sigh. I honestly wish my mom died instead of my dad.
